title: Bearing details.
officialText:
Concentrated loads shall be supported upon construction of solid masonry, concrete, or masonry of
hollow units with cells filled with mortar, grout, or concrete. In addition, construction supporting concentrated loads shall be of
sufficient height to distribute safely the loads to the wall or column, or other adequate provisions shall be made to distribute the
loads.
